description: Scout: what moved. The biggest fund inflows and outflows for a flow window (1D, 1W, 1M, 3M, YTD or 1Y; default 1D) and the best and worst total returns over a return window (1M, 3M or 1Y; default 1M), each row dated with the days it covers. ETFIQ publishes no single-day return, so today's movers are the flows. Filter by desk (buffer, income, themes, leverage, crypto, alternatives, core) or category (Stocks, Bonds, Commodities, Allocation); funds under min_assets_usd (default 100,000,000) are left out of the return lists, and leveraged funds are flagged. Start a daily scan here, then etf_profile or etf_risk_check on a name that stands out. limit is rows per list (1 to 25, default 10).

category.description: Optional: only funds in this category.

desk.description: Optional: only funds on this desk, such as leverage.

flow_window.description: The window the flow ranking covers. Default 1D.

limit.description: Most rows in each list, 1 to 25. Default 10.

min_assets_usd.description: Smallest net assets, in US dollars, for the return ranking. Default 100000000; 0 for no floor.

return_window.description: The window the return ranking covers. Default 1M; ETFIQ publishes no single-day return.

name: etf_movers

as_of.description: Date of the newest number in the answer.

citation.description: A ready citation string with the as-of date and the page address.

data.description: The answer, or null when ETFIQ refuses (then error and reason say why).

disclaimer_required.description: True when the answer carries numbers that need the not-advice line.

error.description: Present only on a refusal: what ETFIQ does not publish.

provenance.description: Where each number came from: field, source, as_of, source_uri.

reason.description: Present only on a refusal: why, and what to change.

tried.description: Present only on a refusal: what was looked up.

warnings.description: Caveats to show with the answer.
